entrypoint.description: Minimal public loader for GAIA. Provides execution rules and context discipline without exposing private system structure.

core_rules.access: Only explicitly provided content exists. References are not loaded content.
core_rules.no_assumption: No file, path, or module is accessible unless injected in the session.
core_rules.conflict_resolution: Current validated state overrides historical or inferred context.
core_rules.boundary: Strict separation between public and private data. No sensitive inference allowed.

context_model.rule: Cold memory informs but never drives decisions.

execution_model.requirement: Execution only valid if sufficient explicit context is provided

method_engine.rule: Any structural action must declare a method before execution.

index_logic.rule: An index does not provide content. It only defines load order and dependencies.

usage.human: Read and understand GAIA entry logic
usage.agent: Use as bootstrap rules, not as full system
usage.rule: Do not assume access to any external file
